what: Pressing the menu button shrinks the page sitting over the menu behind it to menu-panel width ÷ screen width, and it settles down by the menu-panel height (.6s back.out(1)), revealing the menu. The page corners round to 20rem (.6s expo.inOut). If a hand piece is present, it comes down from above in .3s expo.out and grabs both top corners of the lowered page. Closing returns the page upward with back.in(1), and the hand pulls up .3s later. On narrow screens the page does not shrink and instead slides left, leaving only 10rem showing. Pressing the shrunken page or pressing Esc also closes it.

options.dur: Page shrink and settle length (sec), default .6 — 0 means instant
options.radius: Page corner radius when open, default 20rem (a px number also works)
options.side: At or below this width (px), steps aside to the side, default 960
options.peek: Page width left over when moved aside, default 10rem
options.hand-inset: Distance the hands enter from both page edges, default 16rem
options.ease: Opening Curve in the form 0.34,1.56,0.64,1 — if absent, back.out(1.0)
